args.content:
Hawaii Vacation Packing List

Based on Emma Johnson's Hawaii Vacation Itinerary (June 10-20, 2024)

Essential Items:
- Swimwear
- Sunscreen (SPF 30+ recommended)
- Hiking gear (comfortable shoes, light backpack)
- Casual outfits (lightweight, breathable clothing)
- Camera
- Travel documents (ID, passport if needed, hotel confirmations)

Additional Recommended Items:
- Beach towel
- Sunglasses
- Hat or cap for sun protection
- Reef-safe sunscreen (required for some beaches like Hanauma Bay)
- Water shoes for snorkeling
- Light rain jacket (for possible showers)
- Insect repellent
- Reusable water bottle
- Snorkel gear (optional, can be rented)
- Beach bag
- Flip flops/sandals
- Evening attire for the Luau experience
- Phone charger and travel adapter
- Medications
- Cash and credit cards

Activities-Specific Items:
- June 11: Beach day at Waikiki Beach - beach essentials
- June 12: Snorkeling at Hanauma Bay - snorkel gear, underwater camera
- June 13: Hiking at Diamond Head - proper hiking shoes, water, hat
- June 14: Visit to Pearl Harbor - comfortable walking shoes, respectful attire
- June 15: Road trip to the North Shore - car snacks, playlist, directions
- June 16: Luau experience - aloha shirt/dress, camera for photos
- June 17: Hotel spa day - swimsuit, robe (if not provided)
- June 18: Kayaking at Kailua Beach - quick-dry clothes, waterproof bag
- June 19: Shopping at Ala Moana Center - comfortable walking shoes, shopping bags
